decision_rule.comparator: the sealed PLAN arm SAEA-SLURP-NATIVE-DEFAULT-PLAN-LOCK-V1, and nothing else, for every gating clause; margins the plan's own null (PLANr)
decision_rule.NEUTRAL: BOTH guards non-inferior at the plan's own null: the CI95 LOWER bound of the paired official pooled SLU-F1 delta (B9a minus PLAN) exceeds -h_SLU AND the CI95 LOWER bound of the paired intent delta exceeds -h_intent; the Acquisition node is then instantiated in the base as it flew (kind (a), budget 1 / 0) and the base-lock v3 document records it.
decision_rule.ADMITTED: NEUTRAL and, in addition, the pooled SLU CI95 lower bound above zero: reported as a gain.
decision_rule.HARMFUL: owner decision 25's form: a MEASURED LOSS on either guard -- a point estimate below -h or a CI95 UPPER bound below zero. Then the owner decides between locking the node at its OFF null arm (which decision 43 forbids as a registered absence) and a re-scoped kind; nothing is automatic.
decision_rule.acquisition_diagnostic: rows routed to ACQUIRE, items acquired, saves / harms on the acquired rows: reported whatever the verdict; a zero-acquisition flight (the Planner never routes ACQUIRE) is a finding about the Planner, not a NEUTRAL by default -- it is stated as such.
decision_rule.efficiency_is_reported_regardless: every efficiency deliverable is reported whatever the verdict
decision_rule.scenario_diagnostic: the decision-17 net-harmed flag per scenario (five or more) is reported; a breach is a diagnostic beside the verdict, never a gate

diagnostics_required: FINITE COMPLETIONS. The count of rows whose terminal_disposition.reason is "finite_completion", the affected sample ids, the delivered-draft versus abstention split, and -- only if the count is non-zero -- the primary official metric recomputed with those rows excluded BESIDE the registered all-rows number, which stays the number the decision rule reads. No row is ever filtered out of the scored manifest. Expected zero; the anchor side is provably zero (docs/receipts/slurp-finite-completion-exposure-v1.json).

planner_action_illegal. The flight's own count, the sample ids that carry it, and their action character counts and SHA-256 values (the form inherited from the B7a recovery note's section 8). This is the failure item E8c repaired; it is reported whether or not it is zero.

FIRST-REQUEST BYTE IDENTITY: every row's Perception request byte-identical (payload_sha256) to the sealed PLAN arm's for the same sample id (the E18 module renders nothing before the Planner's first visit); the Planner request differs from PLAN's only by the advertised ACQUIRE action; every later divergence is downstream of a route and is reported per row.
THE CONSTANCY TABLE per row from the sealed receipt: mode, rendered_tool_names, the five contact rows with authority_tool_names beside rendered_tool_names, and distinct_tool_schemas_sha256 == 1.

NATIVE TASK-CONTRACT CALL COUNT against the anchor's realized 1,082, and the count of tool calls emitted by a role that holds no authority (expected zero; a non-zero count is not a failure of the flight -- the rail refuses the call and the episode continues -- but it is the single most interesting behavioural consequence of showing three more roles the tool definitions, and it is reported per role).

PER-SCENARIO intent and SLU tables over all 18 scenarios, in BOTH the natural-mixture and the equal-scenario weighting, plus net harmed rows per scenario with any scenario of five or more flagged (owner decision 17) -- a diagnostic the verdict must carry, not an additional gate.
ROW ACCOUNTING: 1,080 in, 1,080 out on both sides, no row dropped and no sample_id invented.

COST: actual generation contacts against the anchor's realized 5,417 and the 11,880 ceiling; actual repeated speech seconds against the anchor's realized 15,459.76; actual FIT endpoints; GPU hours read from the serving monitor over the lease window.

ACQUISITION RECEIPTS: per row the ACQUIRE routes (visit, revision), the acquisition receipt (kind, policy id, provenance ids, item count, dedupe drops, contacts used = 0), the revision outcome; the count of rows whose acquired evidence changed the delivered answer; zero-acquisition flights stated as a Planner finding.

resume_recovery_clause: owner decision 22 of 2026-09-18. If an attempt dies of an INFRASTRUCTURE failure with code and request bytes unchanged -- never a harness or config defect -- the one allowed recovery may be a RESUME-RECOVERY under item E10 instead of a re-fly: every complete row of the aborted attempt is kept without selection, every partial or unstarted row is flown under the same run id, and the merged manifest declares the predecessor attempt with its trace hash, kept-row list and that list's hash. It changes no question, roster, factor, comparator, decision rule or cap, and the run-cumulative budget must be re-checked because a resumed attempt and its predecessor share one run id. A resumed EFFICIENCY read must additionally state the split of its GPU hours and prefilled tokens across attempts, because a merged manifest's cost is the sum of two lease windows and a per-row rate computed over the merged manifest alone would be wrong.
